title.en: How Pregnancy Happens and How It Is Prevented
title.hg: Pregnancy Kaise Hoti Hai aur Kaise Roki Jati Hai

subtitle.en: The outline every teenager should know
subtitle.hg: Woh basic outline jo har teenager ko pata honi chahiye

hook.en: Pregnancy is biology, not luck or magic. Once you know how it happens, most of the myths fall apart.
hook.hg: Pregnancy biology hai, luck ya magic nahi. Ek baar samajh lo ki yeh kaise hoti hai, toh zyadatar myths apne aap gir jate hain.

objectives.en: Explain in outline how a pregnancy begins.
objectives.hg: Outline mein samjha sako ki pregnancy kaise shuru hoti hai.

objectives.en: Know that reliable methods of contraception exist and that delaying sex is a valid choice.
objectives.hg: Jaan sako ki contraception ke reliable methods exist karte hain aur sex ko delay karna ek valid choice hai.

objectives.en: Name trustworthy places to get information and help.
objectives.hg: Information aur help ke trustworthy sources bata sako.

body.en: About once in each menstrual cycle, an ovary releases an egg; this is called ovulation. During vaginal sex, semen containing millions of sperm can enter the vagina, and sperm can travel through the uterus to the fallopian tubes. If a sperm joins the egg (fertilisation) and the fertilised egg settles into the lining of the uterus, a pregnancy begins. Sperm can stay alive inside the body for up to about five days, and the day of ovulation shifts from cycle to cycle. This is why pregnancy can happen the very first time, and why counting 'safe days' is not reliable.
body.hg: Lagbhag har menstrual cycle mein ek baar ovary ek egg release karti hai; ise ovulation kehte hain. Vaginal sex ke dauraan semen, jisme millions of sperm hote hain, vagina mein ja sakta hai, aur sperm uterus se hote hue fallopian tubes tak pahunch sakte hain. Agar koi sperm egg se mil jaye (fertilisation) aur fertilised egg uterus ki lining mein jam jaye, toh pregnancy shuru ho jati hai. Sperm body ke andar lagbhag paanch din tak zinda reh sakte hain, aur ovulation ka din har cycle mein aage-peeche hota rehta hai. Isiliye pregnancy pehli baar mein bhi ho sakti hai, aur 'safe days' ginna reliable nahi hai.

body.en: Contraception means methods that prevent pregnancy. You do not need the details yet, but you should know the main groups. Barrier methods, such as condoms, stop sperm from reaching the egg; condoms are also the only method that lowers the risk of sexually transmitted infections (STIs). Hormonal methods, such as pills and injections, mainly stop ovulation. Long-acting methods, such as IUDs and implants, are placed by a health worker and work for years. Emergency contraception can be used soon after unprotected sex. No method is 100 percent, and each one has to be used correctly to work well.
body.hg: Contraception matlab woh methods jo pregnancy hone se rokte hain. Abhi tumhe details jaanne ki zaroorat nahi, par main groups pata hone chahiye. Barrier methods, jaise condom, sperm ko egg tak pahunchne se rokte hain; condom hi akela method hai jo sexually transmitted infections (STI) ka risk bhi kam karta hai. Hormonal methods, jaise pills aur injections, mainly ovulation rokte hain. Long-acting methods, jaise IUD aur implant, health worker lagate hain aur yeh saalon tak kaam karte hain. Emergency contraception unprotected sex ke baad jaldi use kiya ja sakta hai. Koi bhi method 100 percent nahi hai, aur har method tabhi achhe se kaam karta hai jab sahi tareeke se use ho.

h.hg: Wait karna ek real choice hai

body.en: Not having sex is the only way that is completely certain to prevent pregnancy, and choosing to wait is common and valid, whether for a few years or until marriage. You never owe anyone sex to prove love, maturity or loyalty. In India the law (POCSO) treats any sexual act with a person under 18 as an offence, even if both say they agreed. So waiting also avoids real legal consequences. This law exists to protect under-18s: if anyone pressures, tricks or forces you into anything sexual, it is never your fault, and telling a trusted adult or calling 1098 will not get you into trouble.
body.hg: Sex na karna hi pregnancy se bachne ka akela poori tarah pakka tareeka hai, aur wait karne ka decision common bhi hai aur poori tarah valid bhi, chahe kuch saal ke liye ho ya shaadi tak. Pyaar, maturity ya loyalty prove karne ke liye kisi ke saath sex karna tumhari zimmedari kabhi nahi hai. India mein law (POCSO) 18 se kam umar ke insaan ke saath kisi bhi sexual act ko offence maanta hai, chahe dono bolein ki woh agree the. Isliye wait karne se real legal consequences se bhi bachav hota hai. Yeh law under-18 logon ki protection ke liye hai: agar koi pressure daal kar, bahla kar ya zabardasti tumhe kisi bhi sexual cheez mein kheenche, toh galti kabhi tumhari nahi hai, aur kisi trusted adult ko batane ya 1098 par call karne se tum trouble mein nahi padoge.

body.en: Friends, forwards and random videos get this topic wrong all the time. Better sources are a doctor or nurse, a school counsellor, a parent or another adult you trust, and Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics (AFHC) in government hospitals, which offer free counselling for young people. Asking a question is not an admission of anything. Be aware that health workers must report sexual abuse or sexual activity involving someone under 18, so they cannot promise complete secrecy; that rule exists to protect young people, and you are still entitled to care and respect. If someone is pressuring or forcing you, call Child Helpline 1098.
body.hg: Dost, forwards aur random videos is topic par aksar galat information dete hain. Better sources hain: doctor ya nurse, school counsellor, parent ya koi aur trusted adult, aur government hospitals ke Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics (AFHC), jahan young logon ko free counselling milti hai. Question poochna kisi baat ka admission nahi hai. Yeh jaan lo ki 18 se kam umar ke kisi insaan ke sexual abuse ya sexual activity ka pata chalne par health workers ko report karna hota hai, isliye woh complete secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte; yeh rule young logon ki protection ke liye hai, aur phir bhi care aur respect paana tumhara haq hai. Agar koi tum par pressure daal raha hai ya zabardasti kar raha hai, toh Child Helpline 1098 par call karo.

claim.en: If you learn about contraception, it means you are planning to have sex.
claim.hg: Agar tum contraception ke baare mein seekh rahe ho, toh matlab tum sex karne ka plan bana rahe ho.

fact.en: Knowing how pregnancy is prevented is health knowledge, like knowing first aid. Learning it does not commit you to anything; it helps you spot wrong information now and make safer decisions whenever that time comes.
fact.hg: Pregnancy prevention ki knowledge health knowledge hai, jaise first aid ki knowledge. Ise seekhne se tum kisi cheez ke liye commit nahi ho jate; isse abhi galat information pehchanne mein aur jab bhi woh time aaye tab safer decisions lene mein help milti hai.

takeaways.en: Pregnancy begins when a sperm fertilises an egg that then settles in the uterus, and it can happen the first time.
takeaways.hg: Pregnancy tab shuru hoti hai jab sperm egg ko fertilise kare aur woh uterus mein settle ho jaye, aur aisa pehli baar mein bhi ho sakta hai.

takeaways.en: Reliable contraceptive methods exist, but only condoms also reduce STI risk and no method is 100 percent.
takeaways.hg: Reliable contraceptive methods exist karte hain, par STI risk sirf condoms kam karte hain aur koi bhi method 100 percent nahi hai.

takeaways.en: Waiting is a valid choice, and trusted adults and Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics can answer your questions.
takeaways.hg: Wait karna ek valid choice hai, aur trusted adults aur Adolescent Friendly Health Clinics tumhare questions ke answers de sakte hain.

activity.en: Write down two questions about pregnancy or prevention that you have been too shy to ask. Next to each, write one reliable person or place where you could get the answer.
activity.hg: Pregnancy ya prevention ke baare mein do aise questions likho jo tum sharam ki wajah se pooch nahi paye. Har question ke aage ek reliable insaan ya jagah likho jahan se answer mil sakta hai.

q.en: What has to happen for a pregnancy to begin?
q.hg: Pregnancy shuru hone ke liye kya hona zaroori hai?

options.en: Semen touches the skin of the hands or legs
options.hg: Semen haath ya pair ki skin ko touch kar jaye

options.en: A sperm joins an egg and the fertilised egg settles in the uterus
options.hg: Sperm egg se mile aur fertilised egg uterus mein settle ho jaye

options.en: Two people kiss during the days of a period
options.hg: Do log period ke dinon mein kiss karein

options.en: Two people swim in the same pool
options.hg: Do log ek hi pool mein swim karein

explain.en: Pregnancy needs fertilisation and implantation. Kissing, skin contact away from the genitals and shared water cannot bring sperm to an egg.
explain.hg: Pregnancy ke liye fertilisation aur implantation zaroori hai. Kissing, genitals se door skin contact ya same paani mein hone se sperm egg tak nahi pahunch sakta.

q.en: Choosing to wait and not have sex is a valid choice, and nobody is owed sex as proof of love.
q.hg: Wait karne aur sex na karne ka decision poori tarah valid hai, aur pyaar ke proof ke liye sex par kisi ka haq nahi banta.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Delaying sex is common and valid at any age, and for anyone under 18 the law does not recognise consent to sexual activity at all.
explain.hg: Sex ko delay karna kisi bhi age mein common aur valid hai, aur 18 se kam umar walon ke liye law sexual activity ke consent ko maanta hi nahi.

title.en: Condoms: External, Internal and What Can Go Wrong
title.hg: Condoms: External, Internal aur Kya Galat Ho Sakta Hai

subtitle.en: Barrier methods, STI protection and what to do after a failure
subtitle.hg: Barrier methods, STI protection aur failure ke baad kya karein

hook.en: Condoms are the only contraceptive that also lowers STI risk. They are also the method people most often use wrongly.
hook.hg: Condom akela contraceptive hai jo STI risk bhi kam karta hai. Aur yahi woh method hai jise log sabse zyada galat tareeke se use karte hain.

objectives.en: Explain how external and internal condoms work and how effective they are.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki external aur internal condoms kaise kaam karte hain aur kitne effective hain.

objectives.en: List the common mistakes that make condoms fail.
objectives.hg: Woh common mistakes gina sako jinse condoms fail hote hain.

objectives.en: Know the time-sensitive steps after a condom breaks or is not used.
objectives.hg: Jaan sako ki condom phatne ya use na hone ke baad kaunse time-sensitive steps lene hote hain.

h.hg: Barrier methods kaise kaam karte hain

body.en: Barrier methods physically stop semen from entering the vagina, so sperm never reach an egg. The external condom is a thin sheath, usually latex, worn over the erect penis. With perfect use, about 2 in 100 couples relying on it have a pregnancy in a year; with typical real-life use it is about 13 in 100. The gap comes from human error, not from the material. Condoms are also the only contraceptives that reduce the risk of sexually transmitted infections, including HIV, because they block the exchange of body fluids. They greatly reduce that risk but do not remove it completely.
body.hg: Barrier methods semen ko vagina mein jaane se physically rokte hain, isliye sperm egg tak pahunchte hi nahi. External condom ek patla sheath hai, usually latex ka, jo erect penis par pehna jata hai. Perfect use par, is par depend karne wale 100 couples mein se lagbhag 2 mein ek saal mein pregnancy hoti hai; real-life typical use mein yeh lagbhag 100 mein 13 hai. Yeh gap human error se aata hai, condom ke material se nahi. Condoms akele aise contraceptives bhi hain jo HIV samet sexually transmitted infections ka risk kam karte hain, kyunki yeh body fluids ka exchange rokte hain. Yeh risk bahut kam karte hain, par poori tarah khatam nahi karte.

h.en: Why condoms fail in real life
h.hg: Real life mein condoms kyun fail hote hain

body.en: Most failures are avoidable. Common mistakes are putting the condom on late, after genital contact has begun; not leaving space at the tip; using an expired or damaged one; opening the packet with teeth; using oil-based products such as petroleum jelly, body lotion or cooking oil, which weaken latex; wearing two at once, which increases friction and tearing; and reusing one. A condom should be on from start to finish, held at the base while withdrawing, and thrown in a bin. Heat damages condoms, so a wallet or a vehicle's storage box is a poor place to keep them. Water-based or silicone-based lubricant is safe with latex.
body.hg: Zyadatar failures avoid kiye ja sakte hain. Common mistakes hain: condom late pehenna, jab genital contact shuru ho chuka ho; tip par space na chhodna; expired ya damaged condom use karna; packet daant se kholna; oil-based cheezein lagana, jaise petroleum jelly, body lotion ya cooking oil, jo latex ko weak karti hain; ek saath do pehenna, jisse friction aur phatne ka risk badhta hai; aur ek hi condom reuse karna. Condom start se finish tak pehna rehna chahiye, bahar nikalte waqt use base par pakadna chahiye, aur phir dustbin mein phenkna chahiye. Heat condoms ko damage karti hai, isliye wallet ya gaadi ki dickey rakhne ki sahi jagah nahi. Water-based ya silicone-based lubricant latex ke saath safe hai.

body.en: The internal condom, sometimes called the female condom, is a soft pouch placed inside the vagina before sex; a ring holds it in place at the opening. It lets the receptive partner control protection. About 5 in 100 users have a pregnancy in a year with perfect use and about 21 in 100 with typical use, and it also lowers STI risk. It should not be used together with an external condom, because the two rub and can tear. It costs more and is harder to find in India than external condoms. Other barriers, such as the diaphragm, exist but are uncommon here and give no reliable STI protection.
body.hg: Internal condom, jise kabhi-kabhi female condom bola jata hai, ek soft pouch hai jo sex se pehle vagina ke andar rakha jata hai; ek ring ise opening par tikaye rakhti hai. Isse protection ka control us partner ke haath mein rehta hai jiski vagina mein yeh pehna jata hai. Perfect use par 100 mein se lagbhag 5 aur typical use mein lagbhag 21 mein ek saal mein pregnancy hoti hai, aur yeh STI risk bhi kam karta hai. Ise external condom ke saath use nahi karna chahiye, kyunki dono aapas mein ragad kar phat sakte hain. India mein yeh external condom se mehenga hai aur mushkil se milta hai. Diaphragm jaise doosre barriers bhi hote hain, par yahan kam common hain aur STI se reliable protection nahi dete.

h.en: If a condom breaks, slips or was not used
h.hg: Agar condom phat jaye, slip ho jaye ya use hi na hua ho

body.en: Emergency contraception works up to 5 days after unprotected sex, the sooner the better; it is not abortion and gives no STI protection. If HIV exposure is possible, see a doctor about PEP, which must start within 72 hours. A pregnancy test is reliable from the first day of a missed period, and STI tests may follow. Under POCSO any sexual act involving someone under 18 is an offence even if both agreed, so a doctor must report it and cannot promise secrecy; you are still entitled to care, so do not delay. If anything happened without your agreement, tell a trusted adult or call 1098 or 112.
body.hg: Emergency contraception unprotected sex ke 5 din baad tak kaam karta hai, jitni jaldi utna better; yeh abortion nahi hai aur STI se koi protection nahi deta. Agar HIV exposure possible ho, toh PEP ke liye doctor se milo, jo 72 ghante ke andar start karni hoti hai. Pregnancy test period miss hone ke pehle din se reliable hota hai, aur STI tests baad mein karane ko bola ja sakta hai. POCSO ke under 18 se kam umar ke kisi insaan se juda koi bhi sexual act offence hai, chahe dono agree hon, isliye doctor ko report karna hota hai aur woh secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte; phir bhi care paana tumhara haq hai, isliye delay mat karo. Agar kuch bhi tumhari marzi ke bina hua hai, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

claim.en: Condoms have tiny holes that let sperm and viruses pass through.
claim.hg: Condoms mein chhote-chhote holes hote hain jinse sperm aur virus nikal jate hain.

fact.en: An intact latex condom does not let sperm or HIV pass through. Condoms fail mainly because of how they are used or stored: late application, expiry, oil-based products or tearing.
fact.hg: Intact latex condom se na sperm paas hote hain, na HIV. Condoms zyadatar is wajah se fail hote hain ki unhe kaise use ya store kiya gaya: late pehenna, expiry, oil-based cheezein ya phat jana.

takeaways.en: Condoms are the only contraceptive method that also reduces STI risk, and not having sex yet is a fully valid choice and the only certain protection.
takeaways.hg: Condom akela contraceptive method hai jo STI risk bhi kam karta hai, aur abhi sex na karna poori tarah valid choice aur akela pakka protection hai.

takeaways.en: The difference between about 2 and about 13 pregnancies per 100 users comes from everyday mistakes.
takeaways.hg: 100 users mein lagbhag 2 aur lagbhag 13 pregnancies ke beech ka farq everyday mistakes se aata hai.

takeaways.en: After a failure, emergency contraception has a 5-day window and HIV PEP has a 72-hour window.
takeaways.hg: Failure ke baad emergency contraception ke liye 5 din aur HIV PEP ke liye 72 ghante ka window hota hai.

activity.en: From memory, list five mistakes that make condoms fail. Then check your list against the lesson and, next to each mistake, write the correct practice.
activity.hg: Memory se paanch aisi mistakes likho jinse condoms fail hote hain. Phir apni list ko lesson se match karo aur har mistake ke aage sahi practice likho.

q.en: Which of these is unsafe to use with a latex condom?
q.hg: Inme se kya latex condom ke saath use karna unsafe hai?

options.en: Water-based lubricant
options.hg: Water-based lubricant

options.en: Silicone-based lubricant
options.hg: Silicone-based lubricant

options.en: Petroleum jelly or body oil
options.hg: Petroleum jelly ya body oil

options.en: The lubricant already on the condom
options.hg: Condom par pehle se laga lubricant

explain.en: Oil-based products weaken latex and make tearing more likely. Water-based and silicone-based lubricants are safe with latex condoms.
explain.hg: Oil-based cheezein latex ko weak karti hain aur phatne ke chances badhati hain. Water-based aur silicone-based lubricants latex condoms ke saath safe hain.

q.en: An external condom and an internal condom should not be used together.
q.hg: External condom aur internal condom ek saath use nahi karne chahiye.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: Two condoms rub against each other, and the friction can tear or dislodge them. One condom used correctly protects better than two.
explain.hg: Do condoms aapas mein ragad khate hain, aur is friction se woh phat ya khisak sakte hain. Sahi tareeke se use kiya gaya ek condom do se better protect karta hai.

warning.en: After unprotected sex, time matters: emergency contraception within 5 days and HIV PEP assessment within 72 hours. If sex was forced, or you are under 18, tell a trusted adult or call 1098 or 112.
warning.hg: Unprotected sex ke baad time bahut matter karta hai: emergency contraception 5 din ke andar aur HIV PEP assessment 72 ghante ke andar. Agar sex forced tha, ya tum 18 se kam ho, toh kisi trusted adult ko batao ya 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

title.en: Pills, Injections, IUDs, Implants and the Emergency Pill
title.hg: Pills, Injections, IUDs, Implants aur Emergency Pill

subtitle.en: How the other methods compare, and what the law says if you are under 18
subtitle.hg: Baaki methods ka comparison, aur under-18 ke liye law kya bolta hai

hook.en: The best method on paper is not always the best in real life. The numbers below show why 'typical use' is the figure that matters.
hook.hg: Paper par best method real life mein hamesha best nahi hota. Neeche ke numbers dikhate hain ki asli matter 'typical use' wala figure kyun karta hai.

objectives.en: Explain the difference between typical use and perfect use.
objectives.hg: Typical use aur perfect use ka farq samjha sako.

objectives.en: Compare pills, injectables, IUDs and implants in outline.
objectives.hg: Pills, injectables, IUDs aur implants ko outline mein compare kar sako.

objectives.en: Distinguish emergency contraception from abortion and understand the legal position of under-18s.
objectives.hg: Emergency contraception aur abortion mein farq kar sako aur under-18 ki legal position samajh sako.

body.en: Effectiveness is given as the number of pregnancies per 100 users in the first year. 'Perfect use' means the method is used correctly every time. 'Typical use' includes real life: forgotten pills, late injections, condoms put on late. With no method, about 85 in 100 sexually active couples have a pregnancy within a year. Methods that do not depend on memory have almost no gap between the two figures, while methods that need action every day or every time have a large one. Withdrawal is about 4 with perfect use but about 20 in typical use; fertility-awareness methods vary widely by type, roughly 2 to 23 in typical use.
body.hg: Effectiveness ko aise bataya jata hai ki pehle saal mein 100 users mein kitni pregnancies hui. 'Perfect use' matlab method har baar bilkul sahi tareeke se use hua. 'Typical use' mein real life shamil hai: bhooli hui pills, late injection, late pehna condom. Koi bhi method na use karne par, sexually active 100 couples mein se lagbhag 85 mein ek saal ke andar pregnancy ho jati hai. Jo methods memory par depend nahi karte, unke dono figures mein lagbhag koi gap nahi hota, jabki jin methods mein roz ya har baar kuch karna padta hai, unme gap bada hota hai. Withdrawal (pull out) perfect use mein lagbhag 4 hai par typical use mein lagbhag 20; fertility-awareness methods ke figures type ke hisaab se bahut vary karte hain, typical use mein roughly 2 se 23.

body.en: The combined pill contains two hormones, oestrogen and a progestogen, and mainly works by stopping ovulation. Taken at the same time every day, fewer than 1 in 100 users have a pregnancy in a year; in typical use it is about 7, mostly because of missed pills. Vomiting, severe diarrhoea and some medicines can reduce its effect. Injectable contraceptives are given by a health worker every two or three months depending on the type: about 4 in 100 in typical use, fewer than 1 with perfect timing. Both can change bleeding patterns. A doctor checks suitability first, since combined pills are not safe for everyone. Neither protects against STIs.
body.hg: Combined pill mein do hormones hote hain, oestrogen aur progestogen, aur yeh mainly ovulation rok kar kaam karti hai. Roz same time par lene par 100 mein se 1 se bhi kam users mein ek saal mein pregnancy hoti hai; typical use mein yeh lagbhag 7 hai, zyadatar missed pills ki wajah se. Vomiting, severe diarrhoea aur kuch medicines iska effect kam kar sakti hain. Injectable contraceptives health worker lagate hain, type ke hisaab se har do ya teen mahine mein: typical use mein 100 mein lagbhag 4, aur bilkul time par lagwane par 1 se kam. Dono se bleeding pattern badal sakta hai. Pehle doctor check karte hain ki yeh method suit karega ya nahi, kyunki combined pill har kisi ke liye safe nahi hai. Dono mein se koi bhi STI se protect nahi karta.

body.en: An intrauterine device (IUD) is a small T-shaped device placed inside the uterus by a trained provider. Copper IUDs contain no hormones; hormonal IUDs release a small amount of progestogen. An implant is a thin flexible rod placed under the skin of the upper arm that slowly releases progestogen. All of these work for several years, can be removed whenever the user wants, and fertility returns quickly afterwards. Fewer than 1 in 100 users have a pregnancy in a year, in typical and perfect use alike, because there is nothing to remember. They give no STI protection, so condoms are still needed for that.
body.hg: Intrauterine device (IUD) ek chhota T-shaped device hai jise trained provider uterus ke andar lagata hai. Copper IUD mein koi hormone nahi hota; hormonal IUD thodi matra mein progestogen release karta hai. Implant ek patli, flexible rod hai jo upper arm ki skin ke neeche lagayi jati hai aur dheere-dheere progestogen release karti hai. Yeh sab kai saal tak kaam karte hain, user jab chahe inhe nikalwa sakta hai, aur uske baad fertility jaldi wapas aa jati hai. Typical aur perfect, dono tarah ke use mein 100 mein se 1 se bhi kam mein ek saal mein pregnancy hoti hai, kyunki isme yaad rakhne jaisa kuch nahi hai. Yeh STI se koi protection nahi dete, isliye uske liye condom phir bhi zaroori hai.

h.en: Emergency contraception, abortion and the law for under-18s
h.hg: Emergency contraception, abortion aur under-18 ke liye law

body.en: Emergency contraceptive pills work mainly by delaying ovulation; a copper IUD, which stops sperm from fertilising an egg, is the most effective form. Either can be used up to 5 days after unprotected sex, the sooner the better. EC does not end an established pregnancy, so it is not abortion, and is not for regular use. Abortion is separate: legal in India under conditions and only through qualified providers; a person under 18 needs a guardian's written consent. Under POCSO, any sexual act with someone under 18 is an offence and health workers must report it, so they cannot promise full secrecy. Laws change; this is not legal advice.
body.hg: Emergency contraceptive pills mainly ovulation ko delay karke kaam karti hain; copper IUD, jo sperm ko egg fertilise karne se rokta hai, iska sabse effective form hai. Dono ko unprotected sex ke 5 din baad tak use kiya ja sakta hai, jitni jaldi utna better. EC established pregnancy ko end nahi karta, isliye yeh abortion nahi hai, aur yeh regular use ke liye nahi bana. Abortion ek alag medical procedure hai, jo India mein kuch conditions ke saath legal hai aur sirf qualified providers ke through honi chahiye; 18 se kam umar ke insaan ke liye guardian ka written consent zaroori hai. POCSO ke under 18 se kam umar ke kisi insaan ke saath koi bhi sexual act offence hai aur health workers ko iski report karni hoti hai, isliye woh full secrecy ka promise nahi kar sakte. Laws badalte rehte hain; yeh legal advice nahi hai.

claim.en: The pill works from the moment you take the first one, and missing one or two does not matter.
claim.hg: Pill pehli goli se hi kaam karne lagti hai, aur ek-do pill miss hone se koi farq nahi padta.

fact.en: Protection depends on taking pills consistently. It may not be immediate, depending on when in the cycle the pack is started, and missed pills are the main reason the typical-use figure is about 7 in 100 instead of under 1. The pack leaflet, a pharmacist or a doctor explains what to do after a missed pill.
fact.hg: Protection is par depend karti hai ki pills consistently li jayein. Pack cycle ke kis time start kiya gaya, uske hisaab se protection turant shuru nahi bhi ho sakti, aur missed pills hi main reason hain ki typical-use figure 100 mein 1 se kam ke bajaye lagbhag 7 hai. Pill miss ho jaye toh kya karna hai, yeh pack ka leaflet, pharmacist ya doctor batate hain.

takeaways.en: Typical-use figures include human error and are the realistic guide to how well a method works.
takeaways.hg: Typical-use figures mein human error shamil hota hai, aur yahi batate hain ki koi method real mein kitna kaam karta hai.

takeaways.en: IUDs and implants are the most effective reversible methods because they do not rely on memory.
takeaways.hg: IUDs aur implants sabse effective reversible methods hain kyunki yeh memory par depend nahi karte.

takeaways.en: Emergency contraception prevents pregnancy and is not abortion, and only condoms reduce STI risk.
takeaways.hg: Emergency contraception pregnancy hone se rokta hai aur abortion nahi hai, aur STI risk sirf condoms kam karte hain.

activity.en: Draw a simple table with five rows: external condom, combined pill, injectable, IUD, implant. From this lesson, fill in typical-use pregnancies per 100, whether it protects against STIs, and who has to remember what.
activity.hg: Paanch rows wali ek simple table banao: external condom, combined pill, injectable, IUD, implant. Is lesson se bharo: typical use mein 100 mein kitni pregnancies, STI se protection hai ya nahi, aur kise kya yaad rakhna padta hai.

q.en: Why do IUDs and implants have almost the same typical-use and perfect-use figures?
q.hg: IUDs aur implants ke typical-use aur perfect-use figures lagbhag same kyun hote hain?

options.en: They contain stronger hormones than pills
options.hg: Inme pills se zyada strong hormones hote hain

options.en: A doctor checks them every month
options.hg: Doctor har mahine inhe check karte hain

options.en: They also block sexually transmitted infections
options.hg: Yeh sexually transmitted infections bhi rokte hain

options.en: Once placed, they work without the user having to remember anything
options.hg: Ek baar lag jaane ke baad yeh bina kuch yaad rakhe kaam karte rehte hain

explain.en: The gap between typical and perfect use comes from human error. Long-acting methods remove the daily or per-use step, so there is very little room for error.
explain.hg: Typical aur perfect use ka gap human error se aata hai. Long-acting methods mein roz ya har baar kuch karne ka step hi nahi hota, isliye error ki jagah bahut kam hoti hai.

q.en: Emergency contraception ends a pregnancy that has already begun.
q.hg: Emergency contraception already shuru ho chuki pregnancy ko end kar deta hai.

options.en: True
options.hg: Sahi

options.en: False
options.hg: Galat

explain.en: EC works mainly by delaying ovulation so that fertilisation does not happen. It cannot end an established pregnancy, which is why it is not abortion.
explain.hg: EC mainly ovulation ko delay karta hai taaki fertilisation ho hi na. Yeh established pregnancy ko end nahi kar sakta, isiliye yeh abortion nahi hai.

warning.en: This lesson is general education, not a prescription. A doctor or trained health worker should help choose any method. If you are under 18 and something happened without your agreement, call 1098 or 112.
warning.hg: Yeh lesson general education hai, prescription nahi. Koi bhi method choose karne mein doctor ya trained health worker ki help leni chahiye. Agar tum 18 se kam ho aur kuch tumhari marzi ke bina hua hai, toh 1098 ya 112 par call karo.

title.en: Choosing a Method: The Honest Comparison

subtitle.en: Every reversible method, its numbers, trade-offs and STI protection
subtitle.hg: Har reversible method, uske numbers, trade-offs aur STI protection

hook.en: There is no best contraceptive. There is only the one that fits your body, your life and your ability to use it correctly.
hook.hg: Koi ek 'best' contraceptive nahi hota. Bas woh hota hai jo tumhari body, tumhari life aur use sahi tareeke se use kar paane ki tumhari ability par fit baithe.

objectives.en: Compare contraceptive methods using typical-use and perfect-use figures.
objectives.hg: Typical-use aur perfect-use figures se contraceptive methods compare kar sako.

objectives.en: Describe the main trade-offs of barrier, short-acting hormonal and long-acting methods.
objectives.hg: Barrier, short-acting hormonal aur long-acting methods ke main trade-offs bata sako.

objectives.en: Explain why STI protection is a separate question from pregnancy prevention.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki STI protection aur pregnancy prevention do alag questions kyun hain.

body.en: Figures are pregnancies per 100 users in the first year, typical use first and perfect use second. Implant: under 1 and under 1. Hormonal or copper IUD: under 1 and under 1. Injectable: about 4 and under 1. Combined pill: about 7 and under 1. External condom: about 13 and 2. Internal condom: about 21 and 5. Withdrawal: about 20 and 4. Fertility-awareness methods vary widely by type, roughly 2 to 23 in typical use, and calendar counting alone is not reliable. No method: about 85. The pattern is clear: the less a method depends on doing something correctly every day or every time, the smaller the gap.
body.hg: Yeh figures pehle saal mein 100 users mein hui pregnancies ke hain, pehle typical use aur phir perfect use. Implant: 1 se kam aur 1 se kam. Hormonal ya copper IUD: 1 se kam aur 1 se kam. Injectable: lagbhag 4 aur 1 se kam. Combined pill: lagbhag 7 aur 1 se kam. External condom: lagbhag 13 aur 2. Internal condom: lagbhag 21 aur 5. Withdrawal: lagbhag 20 aur 4. Fertility-awareness methods ke figures type ke hisaab se bahut vary karte hain, typical use mein roughly 2 se 23, aur sirf calendar counting reliable nahi hai. No method: lagbhag 85. Pattern clear hai: koi method jitna kam is baat par depend kare ki roz ya har baar kuch sahi kiya jaye, gap utna chhota hota hai.

body.en: External and internal condoms are the only methods that reduce the risk of STIs, including HIV. They have no hormones, need no prescription and are used only when needed. Their weakness is that they depend on correct use every time: on from the start, the right lubricant, never two together. Many adults combine a condom with a more effective method such as a pill, IUD or implant. This is called dual protection: one method for pregnancy, the condom for infections. Stopping condoms is safer once both partners have tested and agreed to be exclusive. Withdrawal gives no STI protection, and pre-ejaculate can contain sperm.
body.hg: External aur internal condoms hi aise methods hain jo HIV samet STI ka risk kam karte hain. Inme hormones nahi hote, prescription nahi chahiye aur yeh tabhi use hote hain jab zaroorat ho. Inki weakness yeh hai ki yeh har baar correct use par depend karte hain: start se pehenna, sahi lubricant, aur kabhi do ek saath nahi. Bahut se adults condom ke saath koi zyada effective method bhi use karte hain, jaise pill, IUD ya implant. Ise dual protection kehte hain: ek method pregnancy ke liye, condom infections ke liye. Condoms band karna tab zyada safe hai jab dono partners test kara chuke hon aur exclusive rehne par agree hon. Withdrawal STI se koi protection nahi deta, aur pre-ejaculate mein bhi sperm ho sakte hain.

body.en: Combined pills contain oestrogen and a progestogen; progestogen-only pills suit some people who cannot take oestrogen. Both need daily discipline. Periods may become lighter and more regular; nausea, breast tenderness, spotting or mood changes can occur and often settle within a few months. Combined pills are not advised for some people, for example those with certain migraines, a history of blood clots, or smokers over 35, which is why a clinician screens first. Injectables last two or three months per dose; periods often become irregular or stop, and fertility can take several months to return. India's public programme also offers a non-hormonal pill, centchroman, which follows its own schedule.
body.hg: Combined pills mein oestrogen aur progestogen hote hain; progestogen-only pills kuch aise logon ko suit karti hain jo oestrogen nahi le sakte. Dono mein daily discipline chahiye. Periods halke aur zyada regular ho sakte hain; nausea, breast tenderness, spotting ya mood changes ho sakte hain, jo aksar kuch mahinon mein settle ho jate hain. Combined pills kuch logon ke liye advise nahi ki jati, jaise kuch tarah ke migraine wale, jinhe pehle blood clots hue hon, ya 35 se upar ke smokers; isiliye pehle clinician screen karta hai. Injectable ki ek dose do ya teen mahine chalti hai; periods aksar irregular ho jate hain ya ruk jate hain, aur fertility wapas aane mein kai mahine lag sakte hain. India ke public programme mein ek non-hormonal pill, centchroman, bhi milti hai, jiska apna alag schedule hai.

h.en: IUDs, implants and how to decide
h.hg: IUDs, implants aur decide kaise karein

body.en: A copper IUD works for many years without hormones; periods may be heavier or more crampy, especially at first. A hormonal IUD usually makes periods lighter. A trained provider inserts it, which can be uncomfortable, and IUDs suit many people who have not had children. An implant in the upper arm lasts about three to five years depending on type; irregular bleeding is its most common side effect, and it is not yet available everywhere in India. All can be removed early, with fertility returning quickly. The right choice depends on your health history, periods, pregnancy plans, privacy and STI risk, so decide with a clinician. This lesson cannot prescribe.
body.hg: Copper IUD bina hormones ke kai saal kaam karta hai; periods zyada heavy ya zyada cramps wale ho sakte hain, khaaskar shuru ke mahinon mein. Hormonal IUD se periods usually halke ho jate hain. Ise trained provider lagata hai aur lagwate waqt discomfort ho sakta hai, aur IUD aise bahut se logon ko bhi suit karta hai jinke bachche nahi hue hain. Upper arm mein lagne wala implant type ke hisaab se lagbhag teen se paanch saal chalta hai; irregular bleeding iska sabse common side effect hai, aur yeh India mein abhi har jagah available nahi hai. Sabko time se pehle nikalwaya ja sakta hai, aur fertility jaldi wapas aa jati hai. Sahi choice tumhari health history, periods, pregnancy plans, privacy aur STI risk par depend karti hai, isliye clinician ke saath milkar decide karo. Yeh lesson prescribe nahi kar sakta.

claim.en: Natural methods like 'safe days' or pulling out are healthier, so they are the better choice.
claim.hg: 'Safe days' ya pull out jaise natural methods zyada healthy hain, isliye wahi better choice hain.

fact.en: They avoid hormones and devices, but in typical use about 20 in 100 couples relying on withdrawal have a pregnancy in a year, and calendar calculations are not reliable. 'Natural' describes how a method works, not how well it works.
fact.hg: Inme hormones ya devices nahi hote, par typical use mein withdrawal par depend karne wale 100 couples mein se lagbhag 20 mein ek saal mein pregnancy ho jati hai, aur calendar calculation reliable nahi hai. 'Natural' yeh batata hai ki method kaise kaam karta hai, yeh nahi ki kitna achha kaam karta hai.

takeaways.en: Long-acting methods have the lowest typical-use failure because they remove day-to-day error.
takeaways.hg: Long-acting methods mein typical-use failure sabse kam hai kyunki yeh day-to-day error hata dete hain.

takeaways.en: Only condoms reduce STI risk, so many adults pair them with another method.
takeaways.hg: STI risk sirf condoms kam karte hain, isliye bahut se adults unhe kisi aur method ke saath pair karte hain.

takeaways.en: Suitability depends on individual health and plans, so the final choice belongs with you and a clinician.
takeaways.hg: Kaunsa method suit karega, yeh har insaan ki health aur plans par depend karta hai, isliye final choice tumhari aur clinician ki honi chahiye.

activity.en: List what matters most to you in a method: effectiveness, no hormones, privacy, effect on periods, STI protection, cost, how soon you might want a pregnancy. Rank them, then note which two methods you would ask a clinician about.
activity.hg: Likho ki kisi method mein tumhare liye sabse zyada kya matter karta hai: effectiveness, no hormones, privacy, periods par effect, STI protection, cost, kitni jaldi pregnancy chah sakte ho. Inhe rank karo, phir note karo ki kin do methods ke baare mein tum clinician se poochna chahoge.

options.en: Wearing two external condoms at once
options.hg: Ek saath do external condoms pehenna

options.en: Using a condom for STI protection together with another effective contraceptive
options.hg: STI protection ke liye condom ke saath koi aur effective contraceptive use karna

options.en: Taking two pills on the same day
options.hg: Ek hi din mein do pills lena

options.en: Combining withdrawal with counting safe days
options.hg: Withdrawal ke saath safe days ginna

explain.en: Dual protection pairs the condom, which reduces STI risk, with a method that prevents pregnancy more reliably. Two condoms together tear more easily.
explain.hg: Dual protection mein condom, jo STI risk kam karta hai, ke saath aisa method joda jata hai jo pregnancy se zyada reliably bachaye. Do condoms ek saath pehenne se woh zyada easily phat-te hain.

q.en: Which effect is commonly reported with a copper IUD, especially in the first months?
q.hg: Copper IUD ke saath, khaaskar shuru ke mahinon mein, kaunsa effect commonly report hota hai?

options.en: Periods stop completely
options.hg: Periods poori tarah band ho jate hain

options.en: Fertility takes a year to return after removal
options.hg: Nikalwane ke baad fertility wapas aane mein ek saal lagta hai

options.en: Heavier or more crampy periods
options.hg: Zyada heavy ya zyada cramps wale periods

options.en: Nausea from the hormones it releases
options.hg: Usse nikalne wale hormones ki wajah se nausea

explain.en: The copper IUD contains no hormones and can make periods heavier or more painful, mainly early on. Fertility returns quickly once it is removed.
explain.hg: Copper IUD mein hormones nahi hote aur isse periods zyada heavy ya painful ho sakte hain, mainly shuru mein. Nikalwate hi fertility jaldi wapas aa jati hai.

warning.en: General education only. Some methods are unsafe with certain health conditions or medicines; a doctor or trained provider should assess you before you start or switch.
warning.hg: Yeh sirf general education hai. Kuch methods kuch health conditions ya medicines ke saath unsafe hote hain; koi method start ya switch karne se pehle doctor ya trained provider se assessment karana chahiye.

title.en: When Plans Fail: Emergency Contraception and Uncertainty
title.hg: Jab Plan Fail Ho Jaye: Emergency Contraception aur Uncertainty

subtitle.en: EC, missed pills, medicine interactions and when to see a professional
subtitle.hg: EC, missed pills, medicine interactions aur professional se kab milein

hook.en: A broken condom or a missed pill is not the end of the story. What you do in the next few hours and days matters.
hook.hg: Phata hua condom ya missed pill story ka end nahi hai. Agle kuch ghanton aur dinon mein tum kya karte ho, woh matter karta hai.

objectives.en: Describe the forms of emergency contraception and their time limits.
objectives.hg: Emergency contraception ke forms aur unki time limits bata sako.

objectives.en: Explain how illness and other medicines can reduce contraceptive effectiveness.
objectives.hg: Samjha sako ki illness aur doosri medicines contraceptive ka effect kaise kam kar sakti hain.

objectives.en: Know how to handle uncertainty about pregnancy and when to seek professional care.
objectives.hg: Jaan sako ki pregnancy ki uncertainty kaise handle karein aur professional care kab lein.

h.en: Emergency contraception: what it is and is not
h.hg: Emergency contraception: kya hai aur kya nahi

body.en: Emergency contraception (EC) reduces the chance of pregnancy after unprotected sex, a condom failure, missed pills or sexual assault. EC pills work mainly by delaying ovulation, so they help only before ovulation has happened, and they cannot disturb a pregnancy that has already implanted. They can be used up to 5 days (120 hours) afterwards, but effectiveness falls with time, and the most common pill is labelled for use within 72 hours. A copper IUD fitted by a trained provider within 5 days is the most effective option and then continues as regular contraception. EC gives no STI protection.
body.hg: Emergency contraception (EC) unprotected sex, condom failure, missed pills ya sexual assault ke baad pregnancy ka chance kam karta hai. EC pills mainly ovulation ko delay karke kaam karti hain, isliye yeh tabhi help karti hain jab ovulation abhi hua na ho, aur jo pregnancy pehle hi implant ho chuki hai us par inka koi asar nahi hota. Inhe 5 din (120 ghante) baad tak liya ja sakta hai, par time ke saath effectiveness girti jati hai, aur sabse common pill ke pack par 72 ghante ke andar lene ko likha hota hai. Trained provider dwara 5 din ke andar lagaya gaya copper IUD sabse effective option hai aur uske baad regular contraception ki tarah kaam karta rehta hai. EC se STI ki koi protection nahi milti.

body.en: Side effects of EC pills are usually mild and short: nausea, headache, tiredness, breast tenderness or spotting. If you vomit soon after taking the pill, ask a pharmacist or doctor whether it needs repeating. The next period may come a few days early or late. Take a pregnancy test if it is more than a week late, or about three weeks after the unprotected sex. EC pills are less effective than regular methods and do not protect you for the rest of the cycle, so use condoms or start a regular method. Needing EC repeatedly is a signal to talk to a clinician about a method that fits better.
body.hg: EC pills ke side effects usually mild aur short hote hain: nausea, headache, thakaan, breast tenderness ya spotting. Agar pill lene ke thodi der baad vomiting ho jaye, toh pharmacist ya doctor se poocho ki dobara lene ki zaroorat hai ya nahi. Agla period kuch din pehle ya late aa sakta hai. Agar woh ek hafte se zyada late ho, ya unprotected sex ke lagbhag teen hafte baad, pregnancy test karo. EC pills regular methods se kam effective hain aur cycle ke baaki dinon mein protect nahi karti, isliye condoms use karo ya koi regular method start karo. Baar-baar EC ki zaroorat padna is baat ka signal hai ki clinician se kisi better fit hone wale method par baat ki jaye.

h.en: Missed pills, illness and medicine interactions
h.hg: Missed pills, illness aur medicine interactions

body.en: The pill's typical-use failures come mostly from missed or late pills. What to do depends on the type of pill and how many were missed, so read the leaflet or ask a pharmacist, use condoms meanwhile, and consider EC if you had unprotected sex. Vomiting or severe diarrhoea can stop a pill being absorbed. Some medicines make pills, implants and EC pills less effective by speeding up hormone breakdown: certain medicines for epilepsy and tuberculosis (rifampicin-type), some HIV medicines, and the herbal product St John's wort. Most common antibiotics do not. Always tell any prescriber what contraception you use. Copper and hormonal IUDs are not affected.
body.hg: Pill ke typical-use failures zyadatar missed ya late pills se aate hain. Kya karna hai, yeh pill ke type aur kitni pills miss hui is par depend karta hai, isliye leaflet padho ya pharmacist se poocho, tab tak condoms use karo, aur agar unprotected sex hua ho toh EC consider karo. Vomiting ya severe diarrhoea se pill body mein theek se absorb nahi ho paati. Kuch medicines hormones ko body mein jaldi tod kar pills, implants aur EC pills ka effect kam kar deti hain: epilepsy aur TB ki kuch medicines (rifampicin jaisi), HIV ki kuch medicines, aur St John's wort naam ka herbal product. Zyadatar common antibiotics aisa nahi karte. Jo bhi doctor medicine likhe, use hamesha batao ki tum kaunsa contraception use karte ho. Copper aur hormonal IUDs par inka asar nahi padta.

body.en: No method is perfect, so a late period deserves a test, not panic. Home tests detect hCG in urine and are most reliable from the first day of a missed period; a very early negative can be wrong, so repeat it after a few days. If the test is positive, see a doctor early to discuss options; abortion is legal in India under conditions and must be done by qualified providers, never with unsupervised pills. Seek urgent care for one-sided lower abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or fainting, which can signal ectopic pregnancy. Persistent side effects or a long-term health condition are also reasons to see a clinician.
body.hg: Koi bhi method perfect nahi hai, isliye period late ho toh panic mat karo, test karo. Home tests urine mein hCG detect karte hain aur period miss hone ke pehle din se sabse reliable hote hain; bahut jaldi kiya gaya negative test galat ho sakta hai, isliye kuch din baad repeat karo. Agar test positive aaye, toh options discuss karne ke liye jaldi doctor se milo; abortion India mein kuch conditions ke saath legal hai aur sirf qualified providers se karana chahiye, bina supervision ke pills le kar kabhi nahi. Pet ke nichle hisse mein ek taraf dard, vagina se bleeding, kandhe ke sire (shoulder tip) mein dard ya behoshi ho toh turant hospital jao; yeh ectopic pregnancy ke signs ho sakte hain. Side effects bane rahein, ya koi long-term health condition ho, tab bhi clinician se milo.

claim.en: Taking the emergency pill more than once will damage the uterus or cause infertility.
claim.hg: Emergency pill ek se zyada baar lene se uterus damage ho jata hai ya infertility ho jati hai.

fact.en: EC pills do not harm future fertility, and repeated use has no known serious health risks. Frequent use can make periods irregular and is less effective than a regular method, which is why EC is not meant as routine contraception.
fact.hg: EC pills future fertility ko harm nahi karti, aur baar-baar lene se koi serious health risk known nahi hai. Frequent use se periods irregular ho sakte hain aur yeh regular method se kam effective hai, isiliye EC routine contraception ke liye nahi bana.

takeaways.en: EC pills delay ovulation, work best early within a 5-day limit and cannot end a pregnancy.
takeaways.hg: EC pills ovulation delay karti hain, 5 din ki limit ke andar jitni jaldi li jayein utni effective hain, aur pregnancy end nahi kar sakti.

takeaways.en: Missed pills, vomiting and certain medicines can quietly reduce protection, so tell prescribers what you use.
takeaways.hg: Missed pills, vomiting aur kuch medicines chupchap protection kam kar sakti hain, isliye prescriber ko batao ki tum kya use karte ho.

takeaways.en: A late period calls for a test from the first missed day, and warning signs of ectopic pregnancy need urgent care.
takeaways.hg: Period late ho toh miss hone ke pehle din se test karo, aur ectopic pregnancy ke warning signs par turant hospital jao.

activity.en: Make a private 'plan B' note: the 5-day EC window, the 72-hour PEP window, your nearest pharmacy and clinic, and when to take a pregnancy test. You may never need it, but deciding in advance beats deciding in panic.
activity.hg: Apne liye ek private 'plan B' note banao: EC ke liye 5 din ka window, PEP ke liye 72 ghante ka window, sabse paas ki pharmacy aur clinic, aur pregnancy test kab karna hai. Ho sakta hai iski kabhi zaroorat na pade, par pehle se decide kar lena panic mein decide karne se better hai.

q.en: How do emergency contraceptive pills mainly work?
q.hg: Emergency contraceptive pills mainly kaise kaam karti hain?

options.en: By delaying ovulation
options.hg: Ovulation ko delay karke

options.en: By ending an implanted pregnancy
options.hg: Implant ho chuki pregnancy ko end karke

options.en: By killing sperm in the vagina
options.hg: Vagina mein sperm ko maar kar

options.en: By blocking the fallopian tubes
options.hg: Fallopian tubes ko block karke

explain.en: EC pills postpone the release of an egg so that sperm have nothing to fertilise. That is why they work best early and do nothing to an existing pregnancy.
explain.hg: EC pills egg ke release ko postpone kar deti hain taaki sperm ke paas fertilise karne ko kuch na ho. Isiliye yeh jaldi lene par best kaam karti hain aur existing pregnancy par kuch nahi karti.

q.en: Sana took an EC pill after a condom broke. Her period is now ten days late. What should she do?
q.hg: Condom phatne ke baad Sana ne EC pill li thi. Ab uska period das din late hai. Use kya karna chahiye?

options.en: Take another EC pill
options.hg: Ek aur EC pill le le

options.en: Take a pregnancy test, and see a doctor if it is positive or she is unsure
options.hg: Pregnancy test kare, aur positive aane ya doubt hone par doctor se mile

options.en: Assume the EC worked and wait another month
options.hg: Maan le ki EC ne kaam kar diya aur ek mahina aur wait kare

options.en: Start regular pills to bring the period on
options.hg: Period laane ke liye regular pills start kar de

explain.en: EC can shift a period by a few days, but more than a week late calls for a test. EC is not fully effective, and another dose now would do nothing for a pregnancy that may already exist.
explain.hg: EC se period kuch din aage-peeche ho sakta hai, par ek hafte se zyada late hone par test karna chahiye. EC fully effective nahi hai, aur ab ek aur dose us pregnancy par kuch nahi karegi jo shayad already ho chuki ho.

warning.en: With a possible pregnancy, one-sided lower abdominal pain, vaginal bleeding, shoulder-tip pain or fainting needs urgent hospital care. After sexual assault, seek care immediately: emergency contraception, HIV PEP within 72 hours and support are available. Call 112 or 181.
warning.hg: Agar pregnancy possible ho aur pet ke nichle hisse mein ek taraf dard, vagina se bleeding, kandhe ke sire (shoulder tip) mein dard ya behoshi ho, toh turant hospital jao. Sexual assault ke baad immediately care lo: emergency contraception, 72 ghante ke andar HIV PEP aur support available hai. 112 ya 181 par call karo.
